revisions.description: Added reviewed Saint honorifics and profile links across public readings,53 sourced profiles for previously unrepresented named Saints, and ten verified licensed historical depictions. Preserved source wording and study anchors through a presentation-only honorific layer.
revisions.reviewStatus: Primary ecclesiastical recognition and factual source anchors checked. Unknown identities remain unlinked. No independent theological approval or live deployment claimed.

revisions.description: Added a static visitor welcome page with credited church photographs, background library loading, sign-up/login entry links, a hover-expanding icon navigation rail with persistent pinning, a dismissible ten-second beta notice, and a simple email/message feedback form prepared for Netlify Forms.
revisions.reviewStatus: Website presentation and feedback plumbing. Existing religious texts, summary/quotation classifications and study data remain intact. No deployment, live email delivery or independent theological review is claimed.

revisions.description: Put prayers and source readings before publication details, fixed reading size to Comfortable, removed generated-summary badges, simplified prayer display titles, and prioritized daily prayer with occasional published guides retained below.
revisions.reviewStatus: Interface presentation only. Quotation and summary classifications, source wording, prayer boundaries, references, and existing study data remain intact. No new theological review.

revisions.description: Stabilized church-guide step navigation and diagram labels; added a top monthly civil grid over the existing rolling church-year range; added guided navigation for three complete published prayer orders; and added a filter-aware Saints historical timeline.
revisions.reviewStatus: Interface and navigation change using existing sourced records. No religious source wording, prayer-unit boundary, chronology claim, or theological review status changed.

revisions.description: Renamed the local app Holy Apostolic. Added original brocade patterns, paper texture, foliate corners and gilded frames. The existing curriculum, source texts, artwork credits, study records, app location and compatible backup identifiers are retained.
revisions.reviewStatus: Branding and visual change. No religious source wording or theological review status changed.

revisions.description: Expanded local study edition:160 Saints,130 icons,229 lessons,429 glossary terms with paragraph previews, interactive church interior and Liturgy, source-linked authority diagrams and scoped policy examples, restrained manuscript ornament and offline artwork. Original reading IDs and saved progress are preserved.
revisions.reviewStatus: Actual retained-source checks distinguish quotations from necessary summaries. Original printed scans support four explicitly documented historical text collations. No independent theological or jurisdictional approval claimed.

revisions.description: Local sourced pictures on all80 Saints profiles,46 curriculum emblems, a searchable50-entry icon library with artwork, published explanations, Scripture previews and footnotes, restrained visual refinement and offline artwork. This is a curated selection, not a measured popularity ranking.
revisions.reviewStatus: 37 KJV quotations independently matched;202 necessary-summary provenance records and file-specific image credits retained. No independent theological or jurisdictional approval claimed.

revisions.description: Supabase Free account setup, Google/Facebook sign-in, prepared disabled Apple sign-in, email/password recovery, private progress sync, optional email consent and Netlify deployment preparation. No public deployment performed.
revisions.reviewStatus: Software account behavior is separate from religious source verification; live provider setup remains pending.

revisions.description: Expanded80 Saints biographies with sourced backgrounds, life events, death/martyrdom accounts, legacy and chronologies; rolling12-month calendar with civil-date/name/cycle ordering.
revisions.reviewStatus: Text matching and necessary-summary provenance are recorded separately; no independent theological review claimed.

revisions.description: Connected curriculum map, Protestant-background path, Saints, service facsimiles and readers, church year, Scripture/Fathers index, glossary support, notebook, editorial inventory, optional account integration, and offline collections.
revisions.reviewStatus: Text and software checks recorded separately; independent theological review not recorded.

revisions.description: Local Scripture previews with verified Bible corpus and explicit source-numbering choices.
revisions.reviewStatus: Corpus and source-context checks passed; independent theological review not recorded.

revisions.description: Expanded to 144 lessons, 371 glossary entries, 61 native prayers and complete upstream branch highlighting.
revisions.reviewStatus: Quotation matching and browser checks recorded; independent theological review not recorded.

revisions.description: Generated independent static reading pages; responsive canonical navigation, paced section-index loading, preserved legacy links and account progress, and Expand/Collapse sidebar controls. Published source wording and artwork remain unchanged.
revisions.reviewStatus: Interface and architecture update; no independent theological review claimed.

revisions.description: Added source-aligned modern-English teaching to all 229 lessons, preserved original passages in expandable sections, minimized references, introduced Learn/Prayers/Explore navigation, separated the wordmark ornament and fixed ten-second beta dismissal.
revisions.reviewStatus: Editorial source and peer checks recorded separately; no independent ecclesiastical review claimed.
